core_job: For a private pilot who rents a few times a month (and the student pilot): log each flight with what 14 CFR 61 counts, then before the next flight see on one screen whether you are legal for that flight (passengers / night / IFR, medical, flight review) and whether the live weather at your airport is inside your own personal minimums, each with its number, its limit and its lapse date. On-device logbook (sqflite) plus aviationweather.gov METAR/TAF/airport (probe 2026-10-13: 200 for all three). No account.
signature: The Go Card (home tab). Section A, Legal: a pure-Dart legality engine computes 61.57(a)/(b)/(c)+(d), 61.56 and 61.23(d)/BasicMed from the user's entries and profile, with calendar-month arithmetic, the date each item is valid through, and the exact shortfall. This replaces today's wrong getters (night landings not counted toward day, 180 days instead of 6 calendar months, no holds or tracking) and an entry form that cannot record night landings or approaches. Section B, Minimums: the user's own day/night limits checked against live AWC METAR/TAF, including crosswind on the best runway from AWC runways[].alignment (true, matching METAR wind; today's alert_service mixes magnetic and true). Each check is saved to history, and 'Log this flight' closes the loop. Competitors (ForeFlight, Garmin Pilot, MyFlightbook, LogTen) are NOT verified because web search was disabled in this session. Currency alone is not claimed as unique; the claim is the combination.
must: M1 Legality engine in pure Dart (lib/core/legality/, injected clock): 61.57(a) day passengers (3 T/O + 3 landings in 90 days, same category/class, night landings count, tailwheel full-stop); 61.57(b) night full-stop; 61.57(c)/(d) IFR, 6 calendar months, holds + tracking, grace window then IPC, IPC entry resets; 61.56 flight review to end of the 24th calendar month; 61.23(d) medical per class and under-40/40+ answer (no DOB stored) plus BasicMed 48 mo / 24 cal mo. Each result gives validThrough/lapsedOn, shortfall text and cite. Replaces isPassengerCurrent/isNightPassengerCurrent/isIfrCurrent. Fixed-date unit tests for every paragraph and boundary (day 90 vs 91, year rollover, other category not counting).

Hard-coded dayLandings=1 and DateTime.now() at logbook_screen.dart:695-696 removed.

M3 Signature: the Go Card is the home (Today) tab on a fresh install after onboarding. Departure (home by default), optional destination, time, toggles for passengers/night/IFR. Legal section from M1. Minimums section from aviationweather.gov metar/taf/airport directly (Weather tab also moves off rotatepilot.com): ceiling from clouds[] (none reported is not 0), visibility '10+', wind/gust, best-runway crosswind and head/tailwind from runways[].alignment, VRB treated as full crosswind, TAF group for departure +/-1 h, stale flag over 90 min. Tests use recorded real AWC JSON fixtures with UTC capture times; widget test with a fake HTTP client.
